Find samples deeper than the seafloor at their position

Source: R/depth.R
check_depth_vs_seafloor.Rd

For every root sample (no parent) takes the deepest depth attributed to it — its own depth_max_m/depth_min_m, its descendants' and its observations' — and compares it with the deepest GEBCO cell in the 3x3 neighbourhood of its position plus tolerance_m. Positions outside the raster are unknown, not violations.

Usage

check_depth_vs_seafloor(
  con,
  seafloor,
  sample_tbl = "sample",
  obs_tbl = "obs",
  tolerance_m = 10
)

Arguments

con

DBI connection holding sample_tbl (with parent_sample_key, root_sample_key) and optionally obs_tbl.

seafloor

Result of sample_seafloor() (or a GEBCO tif path, in which case it is computed).

sample_tbl, obs_tbl

Table names; obs_tbl may be absent.

tolerance_m

Metres a sample may exceed the neighbourhood-deepest cell before it is a finding (default 10).

Value

A tibble of violators — sample_key, dataset_key, sample_type, cruise_key, longitude, latitude, depth_m, seafloor_depth_m, seafloor_max3x3_m, excess_m, on_land — worst first, with attribute summary: per-dataset n_root, n_unknown, n_over and max_excess_m.
